title: Marketing & Sales Vocabulary
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Has aprendido el vocabulario clave para promocionar productos y analizar el mercado.

parts.visual: Términos clave: Target audience (Público objetivo / audiencia). Market share (Cuota de mercado). Brand awareness (Reconocimiento de marca). Campaign (Campaña publicitaria).
parts.audio: Key terms. Target audience. Market share. Brand awareness. Campaign.

parts.visual: Ventas: Discount (Descuento). Promote (Promocionar). Boost sales (Aumentar ventas). Competitor (Competidor). Launch (Lanzamiento de un producto).
parts.audio: Sales. Discount. Promote. Boost sales. Competitor. Launch, which means the introduction of a new product.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para completar la estrategia de marketing.

questions.question: Who is the ____ audience for this new product? (Público objetivo).
We are going to ____ a new marketing campaign. (Lanzar/Iniciar).
questions.explanation: Launch a campaign/product = lanzar una campaña/producto.

questions.question: We need to increase our brand ____. (Reconocimiento/Conciencia de marca).
questions.explanation: Brand awareness = qué tan conocida es la marca.

questions.question: Our main ____ just lowered their prices. (Competidor).
We offer a 20% ____ for new customers. (Descuento).
We need a new strategy to ____ sales. (Aumentar/Impulsar fuertemente).
questions.explanation: Boost sales = impulsar / disparar las ventas.

questions.question: The company holds a 30% market ____. (Cuota de mercado).
questions.explanation: Market share = cuota o participación de mercado.

questions.question: We should ____ this product on social media. (Promocionar).
Our advertising ____ has been very successful. (Campaña).
We need to do more market ____. (Investigación).
They hired an agency to design a new ____. (Logotipo).
What is our unique selling ____ (USP)? (Propuesta/Proposición de venta).
questions.explanation: USP = Unique Selling Proposition (lo que te hace único).

questions.question: The ____ was a huge success. We sold out in an hour! (Lanzamiento).
We are targeting a specific ____. (Nicho / Segmento muy específico).
The marketing ____ must be approved by the CEO. (Presupuesto).
Word-of-____ is still the best advertising. (Boca a boca).
We are planning a massive ____ strategy. (De precios).
Our goal is to build brand ____. (Lealtad).
questions.explanation: Brand loyalty = lealtad a la marca.

questions.question: They want to ____ the market. (Dominar).
questions.explanation: Dominate the market = dominar el mercado.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de marketing que falta.
